name: Mem0 OSS
one_line: One ADD-only extraction call per add(); zero-LLM hybrid read.

arch.product.t: Python SDK; the managed Platform is a separate product

arch.truth.t: Vector points plus a SQLite history table used for audit only

arch.stores.t: Qdrant by default (24 backends): memory and entity collections; SQLite history and last 10 messages

arch.graphdb.t: Removed in v3 (Platform only); entity back-pointers act as a boost

arch.scope.t: user_id, agent_id or run_id required on every call

write.entry.t: add(messages, scope); the caller decides turn or whole session

write.receipt.t: Batch insert with one-by-one fallback; raises if nothing persisted

write.roles.t: Both speakers extracted; one attributed_to flag (user or assistant)

segment.unit.t: Whatever the caller passes to add()

extract.calls.t: 1 per add() with an about 8k-token system prompt

extract.facts.t: The only layer: self-contained 15-80 word facts from both speakers, ADD-only

extract.dates.t: OSS observation date is the run date (timestamp refused)

extract.neighbours.t: Top 10 existing memories and last 10 messages shown (returned links then discarded)

extract.failure.t: Raises LLMError instead of returning an empty list

graph.entities.t: spaCy mentions (proper, quoted, topic, identifier); no LLM

graph.resolution.t: Merge on exact text or cosine ≥ 0.95

time.update.t: ADD-only; old and new facts both survive

derive.session.t: None (the prompt's summary slot is always empty)

read.legs.t: Dense max(4k, 60); BM25 and entity boost scored only on dense candidates

rank.fusion.t: Additive: semantic + sigmoid(BM25) + entity boost, divided by the best reachable score

answer.shape.t: A list of memory dicts; the caller formats

answer.prompt.t: Not in the clone (short answers reported)

trust.provenance.t: No link from a memory to its source turn

keep: Zero-LLM read path with explainable additive scoring
avoid: linked_memory_ids requested from the model, then discarded
Observation date is the run date in OSS
Candidates come only from the dense leg; exact-hash dedup only

token_economy.t: Facts are 15-80 word self-contained statements, so each memory is short, but the published run retrieves top_200 (about 7k tokens). Extraction prompt itself is about 8k tokens per add().

speed.t: Zero LLM at search; one extraction call per add(); batch embedding and batch insert; vendor p50 latency 0.88 s (Platform).

locomo.protocol: managed Platform, top_200 memories (~7k tokens), gpt-5 reader and judge, 1,540 q

source_doc: consolidated from the earlier engine documents
